subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Mariner 1 Hyphen Bug
description: Learn Mariner 1 Hyphen Bug in one minute.

hook.text: A $18.5 million rocket veered off course 293 seconds after launch. The cause? A missing symbol in the code.

buildup.text: Mariner 1, NASA's Venus probe, launched in 1962. It immediately deviated from its planned trajectory.

discovery.text: A missing overbar in a handwritten formula was transcribed incorrectly into the guidance software.

twist.text: The range safety officer destroyed the rocket 293 seconds in. A single transcription error ended the mission.

climax.text: Science fiction author Arthur C. Clarke called it 'the most expensive hyphen in history.'

punchline.text: One missing symbol. One destroyed rocket. Details matter.

quiz.question: What caused the Mariner 1 failure?
options: A missing symbol in the guidance code
